name: Palacios de la Sierra (Spain)
description: Light blue field with a green hill rising from the base outlined in white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Palacios de la Sierra (a wheel, a chequy field and a tree on red).
history: Municipal flag of Palacios de la Sierra; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
